full_track.tags: Symphonic power metal with operatic female vocals. Orchestral elements include a full string section, brass fanfares, and a large choir. The rhythm section consists of double-kick drumming with rapid sixteenth-note patterns and a distorted electric bass. Electric guitars perform palm-muted gallops and harmonized lead melodies. The arrangement features frequent tempo shifts and dramatic orchestral swells. Key of D minor. 160 BPM.
